display.purpose: Hero headlines only. Used once per page, max 20 characters.

headline.purpose: Section titles and page headers. Appears 2-4 times per page.

title.purpose: Card titles, sub-sections, and component headers.

body.purpose: Paragraphs, descriptions, and form labels. Max line length 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, form labels, navigation items, and metadata. Always uppercase.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Subtle lift for inputs and small elements on light backgrounds.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Default card shadow at rest on light backgrounds.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Hover state for cards and elevated elements.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all transitions. Creates a snappy, confident feel.

motion.name: motion-slow

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA button. Brand green fill, white text, pill shape.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.625rem; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.98rem; line-height: 1; padding: 14px 26px; background-color: var(--color-brand, #308f40); color: #fff; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: var(--color-brand-600, #226f31); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand, #308f40); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.99); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary button. Transparent background, ink border, for non-primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.625rem; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.98rem; line-height: 1; padding: 14px 26px; background-color: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #242627); border: 1.5px solid var(--color-line, #e2e4e5); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink, #242627); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand, #308f40); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button on Dark
components.description: Ghost variant for dark backgrounds. White text, subtle white border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost-dark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.625rem; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.98rem; line-height: 1; padding: 14px 26px; background-color: transparent; color: var(--color-on-dark, #f3f7f4); border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost-dark:hover { border-color: var(--color-on-dark, #f3f7f4); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-ghost-dark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand, #308f40); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Clickable card for service listings. Image + title + description + CTA arrow.
components.html:
Ingeniería

Diseño y gestión de proyectos industriales.

Conocer más →
components.css: .ds-service-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--theme-bg-elevated, #1e2a23); border: 1px solid var(--theme-border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)); border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), border-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 250ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-service-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: var(--color-brand, #308f40); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); } .ds-service-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand, #308f40); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-service-card__img { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; background: var(--theme-bg, #0d1611); } .ds-service-card__body { padding: 18px 20px 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; flex: 1; } .ds-service-card__title { color: var(--theme-text, #f3f7f4); font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 1.06rem; font-weight: 700; margin: 0; } .ds-service-card__desc { color: var(--theme-text-muted, #9bab9f); font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.55; margin: 0; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; } .ds-service-card__cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-top: auto; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--theme-eyebrow, #62bb74); }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: Section introducer. Uppercase text with decorative line to the left.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--theme-eyebrow, #62bb74); margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-eyebrow::before { content: ''; width: 42px; height: 2px; background: currentColor; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input with label, focus ring, and error state.
components.css: .ds-input-wrapper { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-input-label { font-family: 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--theme-text-muted, #9bab9f); } .ds-input { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--theme-text, #f3f7f4); background-color: var(--theme-bg-elevated, #1e2a23); border: 1px solid var(--theme-border, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)); border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--theme-text-subtle, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)); } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--color-brand, #308f40); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--color-brand, #308f40); }

narrative.overview:
This design system conveys the authority and reliability of heavy industrial operations. The aesthetic is dark, grounded, and technical — like the control room of a mining operation. Graphite surfaces provide a serious backdrop for content, while the brand green (#308f40) signals action and availability. The system prioritizes clarity over decoration, technical proof over marketing claims, and operational readiness over visual novelty.

The density is moderate: generous whitespace in headers and CTAs, tighter packing in service grids and equipment cards. The system uses a dual-theme approach (dark graphite default, light surface optional) with semantic tokens that adapt automatically.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first with graphite surfaces (#0d1611) as the default canvas
Brand green (#308f40) used sparingly for CTAs and interactive elements
Condensed industrial typography (Archivo) for headings, clean sans-serif (Inter) for body
Generous use of backdrop-filter blur for glassmorphic overlays on hero images
Eyebrow pattern (uppercase + decorative line) as the universal section introducer
Rounded pill buttons (999px radius) for a modern industrial feel
Subtle hover animations (translateY -2px to -4px) for tactile feedback

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The brand green (#308f40) is used on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Graphite Gradient Rule
rules.body: Dark sections use graphite (#0d1611), graphite-2 (#15201a), and graphite-3 (#1e2a23) in sequence to create depth without hard borders. Never mix graphite with pure black (#000).

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Every section introduction uses the eyebrow pattern: uppercase text (0.8rem, 700 weight, 0.16em letter-spacing) with a 42px decorative line to the left.

rules.name: The Balance Rule
rules.body: Display and headline text uses text-wrap: balance to prevent orphaned words. Never disable this for aesthetic reasons.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, focus, active). Never use shadows on dark backgrounds — use tonal layering instead.

rules.name: The Blur Rule
rules.body: Backdrop-filter blur (12px) is used for glassmorphic overlays on hero images. Always pair with a semi-transparent background and a subtle border.

dos: Use the eyebrow pattern (uppercase + decorative line) to introduce every section
Use brand green (#308f40) sparingly — only for primary CTAs, active states, and interactive highlights
Use graphite surfaces (#0d1611, #15201a, #1e2a23) in sequence for dark sections
Use backdrop-filter blur (12px) with semi-transparent backgrounds for glassmorphic overlays
Use pill radius (999px) for buttons and tags
Use text-wrap: balance for display and headline text
Use translateY(-2px to -4px) for hover lift on cards and buttons
Use semantic tokens (var(--theme-*)) for theme-aware colors
donts: Don't use brand green on more than 10% of any given surface
Don't mix graphite with pure black (#000)
Don't use shadows on dark backgrounds — use tonal layering instead
Don't disable text-wrap: balance for display and headline text
Don't use backdrop-filter without a semi-transparent background
Don't use will-change permanently on any element
Don't hardcode rgba(255, 255, 255, *) values for text on dark backgrounds
